summary: First Integrator plan. Nothing new is proven this week: macro fit still fails, and the forward log for the agent layers has no settled ideas yet (first ones settle around Oct 22-23). The biggest untapped edge is already in the research: the 'spring' (failed breakdown, trap_long) after a breadth thrust made +0.46R (t 6.6, worked after 5 of 6 thrusts) but is not in the playbook, and we are in a post-thrust window right now (Oct 15). Best next step: confirm its halves and per-thrust results, then add it to the post-thrust playbook during this weekend's 'review my trade setups' session.

items.title: Add the Spring (trap_long) to the post-thrust playbook
items.where: trade_setups / playbook_state: new setup 'Spring' next to Box Retest on the Trade Setups tab (boxCard tiles already list trap_long names)
items.how: boxes.attach already finds trap_long names; feed the 'failed' and 'far' tags into the playbook as a setup ranked by backtested 5-session R in each state, so it shows as Focus only after a thrust (and wherever else its R earns it). Plan from the study: entry next open, stop 0.5 ADR back under the line, target the far side. Do it inside the 'review my trade setups' session the Reviewer already flagged.
items.test: Already: thr05 +0.46R, t 6.6, positive after 5 of 6 thrusts. Still needed: split by halves (same sign), count per independent thrust episode (boxstudy.episodes) so one big thrust isn't the whole result, and 5-session R (playbook uses R5) at next-open entry.
items.kill: Either half negative, or the edge comes from 1-2 thrusts only, or R5 after a thrust below +0.15R (not Focus).

items.title: Setups filtered by volume tilt
items.where: playbook_state (a tilt modifier on the state) or a Decision-Card Market note; volume_tilt layer
items.how: Tilt already changes SPY's next 21 sessions (low tilt outside thrust windows -4.2%, low post-thrust +2.4%). Test whether the same tiers change the R of our own setups; if so, 'Buyers tiring' days would mark every setup one notch down (Focus to Selective) on the playbook.
items.test: Re-use tools/picks_context/capture.py (signals.pkl, 5,394+ signals): actionable 5-session result by tilt tier (low no-thrust / low post-thrust / balanced / high), cluster by date, both halves, t = 2 on the low-no-thrust vs rest difference over 20+ dates.
items.kill: Difference |t| 2, or halves disagree, or it's explained away by breadth regime (check within mixed breadth only).

items.title: FINRA short-sale volume (DIX-style) market layer
items.where: new market-context layer (Breadth tab tile) via a fetch step in .github/workflows/daily.yml (the file is blocked in Claude's sandbox but reachable from Actions)
items.how: Fetch FINRA's daily CNMS short volume files (free, from Aug 2018) in a one-off Actions job, build a market-wide short-volume ratio (dollar-weighted on our universe) and store it as a csv. If it passes, add a daily fetch and a tile. Code only, no agent needed.
items.test: Daily ratio and its 10-day avg vs SPY next open to 5/10/21 sessions; must add information beyond ratio10, dn_share10, T2108 and vtilt10 (residual IC, both halves 2018-2022 / 2022-2026, extreme-tier returns with t = 2).
items.kill: Residual IC near 0 or halves disagree: file it as 'doesnt' so it isn't retried.

items.title: Position ideas list (3-month holds, 50-EMA exit, size by ADR)
items.where: new list on the Setups tab, separate from the 5-day Top 2; layers rotation_tier, rs_rating, position_exits, position_sizing
items.how: Top 2 by Leaders score in 'leading & accelerating' sub-themes, held up to 3 months with a close-below-50-EMA exit and a size note (so a 30% drawdown costs about 1% of the account). Its own forward log, like the pick ledger.
items.test: Re-run with the dashboard's exact RS / rotation code (the study used approximations), non-overlapping monthly starts, next-open entry, vs SPY, both halves. The card already says the second half was -4% vs SPY for every rule, so this is the key risk.
items.kill: Second half still negative vs SPY with exact code, or 50-EMA exit not better than holding by a clear margin.

items.title: Agent layers: keep logging, judge in late November
items.where: catalyst, calendar, macro_brief (Decision Cards, forward log)
items.how: Nothing to build. The forward log has 48 carded ideas and none settled. Keep the catalyst and macro agents running; the Reviewer tests them once there are ~60 settled ideas over 20+ dates.
items.test: Forward log: ideas with a real catalyst vs none, red flag vs none, earnings inside hold vs not; t = 2 over = 20 dates, same sign in both halves.
items.kill: No layer reaches |t| = 1 by ~100 settled ideas: cut the catalyst agent to earnings checks only (cheaper).

items.title: Thrust 'unconfirmed' and washout-beta: wait for more events
items.where: volume_tilt tile wording; washout_thrust card (both info only)
items.how: Both rest on 2 events. Keep them as experimental wording; log the outcome of the Oct 15 thrust (unconfirmed by Oct 16's selloff) as the third case: SPY next 21 sessions and the post-thrust playbook's results.
items.test: Needs 8+ cases before any test; then post-thrust setup R with vs without 'unconfirmed'.
items.kill: If the Oct 15 thrust works like a normal one, drop the 'unconfirmed' wording back to a footnote.
